verdict.rationale: stagewise ships a plugin system that connects the agent to external tools. Documented plugins include GitHub (issues, PRs, actions), Supabase and Figma, and these can extend agent context and be invoked via slash commands. However, none of the story's named workflow tools (Jira, Slack, Google Drive) appear, and there is no evidence of a generic connector mechanism for adding arbitrary services. Missing for 10: Jira integration, Slack integration, Google Drive integration, a documented generic or custom connector path for arbitrary workflow tools, and independent corroboration that the plugins work.
